Subject: Pending 7A cases - regarding

Sir,

It is intimated that the Ministry of Labour & Employment has expressed serious concern
about long pendency of 7A cases for over 5 years in EPFO vide its letter no. R-11025/2/2018-
SS-II (Pt.3) dated 07-12-2018. The matter was also discussed in the review meeting by the
Secretary (L&E) held on 30-11-2018, in connection with the actionable points in the tour
reports of the Nodal/Area officers.

2 Accordingly, following directions are issued to ensure monitoring and time-bound
disposal of such 7A cases:

(i) All concerned officers should liquidate all 7A cases pending for over 5 years within
the period of next six months without fail, and all 7A cases pending for over 1
year should be liquidated by 31-12-2019.

(ii) Explanation for 7A cases pending for over 5 years is required to be submitted by
concerned Officer In-Charge of Regional Offices. Same are to be compiled by ACC
(Zones) and forwarded to this office, along with their remarks by 15-02-2019.

(iii) It should be ensured by concerned assessing officer that undue and long
adjournments are not given in pending 7A cases, without justifiable grounds, to
be recorded in writing. At the time of review of 7A orders by superior authority, in
accordance with existing HO instructions, the concerned authority must record in
his findings as to whether any undue and long adjournments were granted during
the proceedings.

3 Above instructions are to be strictly followed and compliance should be ensured and
reported through ACC (Zones).

Yours sincerely,

Additional Central PF Commissioner (HQ) - Compliance
